critique_history.assessment:
- The creature renders far too dark and small, making its texture and anatomy difficult to read; brighten the olive material and strengthen the silhouette.
- Several limbs are hidden against the torso, and the grasping multi-toed feet are barely recognizable; spread all four limbs and enlarge the toes.
- The head and eyes look lumpy and poorly integrated; use a clearer rounded head with attached, upward-visible eye turrets.
- Dark speckling and the spinal ridge need stronger visible coverage.
The model clearly presents a flattened olive chameleon with four attached grasping limbs, prominent eyes, a subtle spinal ridge, speckled leathery skin, and an extremely long tapered tail.
